subject: Onboarding rally plan, kickoff window, weekly cadence & final readout
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Clark <evan@datashelf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed onboarding rally (kickoff window + weekly readouts)

Thanks for the call this morning, Evan — good alignment on goals. I wanted to capture the outcomes and proposed next steps so we have an actionable plan to get the trial moving. TL;DR: kickoff the week of Nov 29, weekly 30-minute syncs, final readout 4 weeks after kickoff.

Call highlights / confirmed success criteria:
- 80% intent-classification accuracy on DataShelf customer-support transcripts (measured on holdout test set)
- Average generation latency under 250ms p50 for 512-token prompt patterns
- No PII leakage in outputs; integration will be scoped to redacted transcripts

Proposed timeline / milestones:
- Week of Nov 29: Kickoff + environment access (sandbox creds, sample data ingestion)
- Week 1: Baseline inference run + smoke test; initial metrics capture
- Week 2: Iteration on prompt templates and batching config; KV cache tuning
- Week 3: Scale-up test and acceptance run; readiness checklist
- Week 4: Final readout, recommendations, next-steps for production

Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood technical lead: Marissa Cole — responsible for runtime config, model variant choices, and test runs
- Redwood integration lead: Aditya Rao — sandbox onboarding, sample ingestion scripts, S3 transfer
- DataShelf PM: Evan Clark — success criteria sign-off, data provisioning, procurement coordination

Immediate asks from DataShelf (to unblock kickoff):
1) Sandbox S3 credentials with access to redacted transcript bucket
2) Sample holdout (≈5k rows) and schema description
3) Procurement contact for SOW and PO process (if different from this thread)

I've attached a mutual action plan template and a straw SOW for procurement to review. If Nov 29 works for you, we'll pencil that in and follow up with calendar invites + the kickoff agenda.

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-DataShelf.pdf

Cheers,
Mina
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Evan Clark <evan@datashelf.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataShelf Procurement <procurement@datashelf.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed onboarding rally (kickoff window + weekly readouts)

Thanks, Mina — this is exactly what we needed to move forward. Confirming the success criteria look right to me (intent accuracy + latency + PII guardrails). A few notes: 

- Nov 29 kickoff works from our side. Can we do Tue Nov 30 at 10 AM PT?
- I'll loop in procurement (cc above) for the SOW/PO; procurement will want an estimated spend band and a short list of deliverables tied to milestones.
- For the sample holdout: we'll share a redacted CSV (fields: ticket_id, user_text, agent_text, label) by EOD Monday.
- Also: we need a short security note about where logs will live during the trial (we prefer logs to be disabled by default; if logging is required we need retention <= 30 days).

I'll send a calendar invite for Nov 30 once procurement confirms the PO timing. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Evan
Head of Product, DataShelf
evan@datashelf.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed onboarding rally (kickoff window + weekly readouts)

Mina — thanks for the clear plan. Internal next steps and owners below. I'll build the runbook doc in Drive and drop the read-only link in this thread.

Assigned owners:
- Kickoff & runtime config (Marissa) — I'll have the runtime checklist ready and the initial model variant baked into the baseline run
- Data ingestion & test harness (Aditya) — will prepare ingestion scripts and a small ETL to validate schema
- Observability & cost tracking (Logan) — will wire token/latency dashboards and set an initial budget cap alert

Internal checklist for Nov 30 kickoff:
- Confirm sandbox creds (wait for DataShelf share)
- Share runbook + test plan with DataShelf 24 hours before kickoff
- Prepare baseline model weights and a short README for the team
- Draft the acceptance gate criteria doc (simple pass/fail checks aligned to Mina's bullets)

Links: SOW draft uploaded here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDEF-map (I'll update with runbook sections tomorrow)

I'll plan to run a 30-min internal pre-kickoff on Nov 29 (11:00 AM PT) to make sure we have everything staged. If Aditya/Logan can't make that slot, ping me alternatives.

—Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Clark <evan@datashelf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed onboarding rally (kickoff window + weekly readouts)

Evan — Nov 30 at 10 AM PT is confirmed on our side; invite incoming. Quick confirmation of the cadence & what we'll deliver each week so everyone's aligned:

Cadence:
- Weekly 30-min sync (Tuesdays, 10:00 AM PT) — standing invite will include DataShelf engineers + our three leads
- Slack channel: #ds-redwood-poc (we'll create once creds are in place)

Weekly deliverables (summary):
- Week 0 (Kickoff): access, ingestion test, baseline plan, acceptance gate draft
- Week 1: baseline run results + initial prompt templates and latency snapshot
- Week 2: tuned configs, updated batch strategy, interim acceptance check (intent metric update)
- Week 3: scale test & final acceptance run; pre-readout slides prepared
- Week 4: readout meeting + decision brief (recommendations + go/no-go)

We will keep the trial scoped to redacted data only, and logs will be disabled unless you explicitly opt-in. Regarding procurement, Marissa will follow up on the SOW timeline once procurement confirms target PO date.

Attached: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx (simple milestone table with owners)

Thanks — see you on Nov 30.

Mina
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Evan Clark <evan@datashelf.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataShelf Procurement <procurement@datashelf.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed onboarding rally (kickoff window + weekly readouts)

Confirmed — invite received and procurement is reviewing the SOW now. We'll upload the sample holdout by 11/16 EOD (apologies for the slight timing). One ask from procurement: can you add a short appendix to the SOW that lists data handling during the trial (where artifacts land, who can access them, retention policy)? They want that before issuing a PO.

I'll follow up if anything else pops up. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Evan
